## Outcome and scope

Explain the problem and resulting behavior in plain English. Link the issue with `Closes #N` if this delivers all of it, or `Refs #N` with remaining work listed. Describe any scope changes needing owner approval.

## Verification

List commands/checks actually run and their results. Identify failed, skipped, and unrun checks. Separate local verification from GitHub CI, browser review, and deployment.

## Owner review

Explain how to inspect the result (for documentation, link the relevant files on this branch), known gaps, and any decision needed. State whether the acceptance criteria are satisfied.

## Documentation and handoff

- [ ] Affected docs and status are accurate; current PR work is distinguished from merged `main`.
- [ ] The roadmap and issue links reflect the scope; no unfinished feature is described as delivered.
- [ ] Remaining work and the post-merge status/Issue #4 refresh are identified where relevant.

Await owner approval before merging. Do not start the next task automatically.
